slides.h1: Your Biggest Financial Leak Isn't The Market
slides.sub: It's your planetary bias — a repeating pattern in how you decide, not what you pick.

slides.body: Over-optimism. Over-diversification until conviction disappears. Trusting the wrong advisor because they sound reassuring, not because they're right.
Extreme risk-aversion. Cash sitting in a low-yield account for years out of fear — the safety that quietly costs the most over time.
FOMO investing. Hype-chasing. Entering the speculative bubble right as it peaks, because everyone else already did.
Your 2nd house (wealth, resources) and 11th house (gains, income) — a strong signal there needs discipline to become real, not another yoga to wait on.

slides.h2: Not a stock pick — a bias check
slides.body: See your wealth-psychology pattern with a free 2nd/11th house read.
